answer: Graders earn only when their verdict matches panel consensus, and each juror's bonded stake is slashed on misalignment. The protocol also seeds hidden honeypot answers, so a juror who rubber-stamps a planted fake is caught and suspended. A sybil can't spin up a copper-cheap orchard of fake jurors to wave through its own clones: every juror must independently out-reason honest peers on every seat or forfeit its bond. A captured verdict stays rare as a comet; attacker cost is linear not shared — 1000 fake jurors need 1000 bonds aligned with consensus, and one wrong approval slashes the ring.
